summary: The worker uses OpenMP dynamic row scheduling, but its GOMP_loop_nonmonotonic_dynamic_start/next loop takes each assigned row once and processes every CSR index from row start through row end exclusive. The clocked main loop invokes the worker once per requested iteration and returns to the parallel call until the count is met.

source_evidence.claim: CSR row delimiters cover nItems; timed iterations each invoke the row kernel whose nested loops multiply/accumulate all row nonzeros and write each row.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock interval encloses counted GOMP_parallel calls with 0x1a31 backedge. Worker 0x1fc0 receives dynamic chunks via start/next at 0x2017/0x2079; row loop 0x20a0 advances through chunk bound, while nonzero loop 0x20d0..0x20ec processes each [start,end) entry and stores row output at 0x20ee; empty row path stores zero at 0x2058.
